Even with this on on all my posts I still have to block like 50 AI reply accounts per day, it's getting crazy on here

I think it's because @spacexai lets you let Grok use your X account

It's crazy cause now they post shitty AI replies on regular accounts of people that the people I follow (aka "accounts you follow & who they follow")

I DM'd a few of those ppl I follow that they follow AI bot accounts but of course it's a drop in a bucket

It'd help if AI replies actually added something to the convo but they don't, it's always some basic shit like 

"paying bills is where every agent demo dies" 

or 

"claude wrote a whole graphics layer and the only leftover bug is that phones are vertical"

???
posts.text_zh:
即使我所有帖子都开启了这个设置，我每天还是得屏蔽大约 50 个 AI 回复账号，这里越来越疯狂了。

我觉得这是因为 @spacexai 允许你让 Grok 使用你的 X 账号。

离谱的是，现在它们用普通人的账号发布垃圾 AI 回复，而这些人又被我关注的人关注着（也就是“你关注的账号及他们关注的人”）。

我私信了几位我关注的人，告诉他们关注了 AI 机器人账号，但这当然只是杯水车薪。

如果 AI 回复真的能给对话增加点价值还好，但它们没有，总是些浅薄的废话，比如：

“支付账单是每一个智能体演示的死亡之地。”

或者：

“Claude 写出了一整套图形层，唯一剩下的 bug 却是手机是竖着用的。”

？？？

quoted_posts.author: ryanlanciaux
quoted_posts.text:
It's so obnoxious. I have a much much smaller reach and any of my posts that get outside normal follower band gets some AI reply bots. 

I don't understand what the people running the account think it does for them. It's so so easy to spot too. 

"here's a complete regurgitation of your post but with strong AI tells." 

ALSO not sure what the platform gains by allowing this. Maybe they're working on a fix but I keep wondering if it's going to get to a point where people leave / lock down the conversation (hurting conversation) / etc. Basically it seems on a long enough timeframe it hurts the platform more than the money they get from the people paying for the $8/month bot account.
quoted_posts.text_zh: 太烦人了。我的触达小得多，但只要帖子超出平常粉丝圈，就会冒出一些 AI 回复机器人。不懂这些人开号图什么，而且特别好认：“把你的帖子完整复述一遍，但带着明显的 AI 痕迹。”也不确定平台允许这事有什么好处。也许在修，但我一直担心最终会有人离开 / 锁帖（伤害讨论）等。长期看对平台伤害可能大于每月 8 美元的机器人账号收入。
